implementation_contract.source_boundary: source requires a handwritten singly linked-list structure with create/read/update/delete behavior but does not preserve language or API shape
implementation_contract.candidate_api: generic Java list with add, index-based insert/get/set/remove, size/isEmpty and a test-only invariant checker
implementation_contract.oracle: java.util.ArrayList<Integer> differential model over the same index semantics
implementation_contract.representation_invariants: empty head/tail/size agreement; non-empty head/tail; tail.next null; reachable node count equals size; final reachable node equals tail; traversal bounded by size

checks: get and set including returned old value
5000 deterministic randomized CRUD operations compared step-by-step with ArrayList
representation invariant validation after every randomized operation
